posts.title: Stepping Stones As a Way-finding Vehicle
posts.description: Stepping stones provide us with the proper way of life. To step on stones is to build towards what is interesting but unknown. Stepping stones as a way-finding vehicle is what we need.

Today I flew to a land known as Austin in a magical de vice with four wheels that spin and spin and spin. The spinning doesn’t end. The coffee I got made my head spin with tales of the bitterness, but it was charming. Thank you to the lady who made the coffee this morning, what a blessing. posts.title: Manipulating Time Containers to Suffer Less
posts.description: At any moment we feel a “felt width” of the time horizon we are holding in experience. Experience holds an implicitly held or deliberately manipulated span of time, like a container. For instance, right now your felt container is probably something like 30 seconds, or however long you think it will take to read this.
